faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our virtual staging platform.

items.question: How long does it take to generate a staged photo?
items.answer: Most renders are completed in under 30 seconds. Complex scenes or 360 panoramas may take up to a minute.

items.question: Is the furniture real?
items.answer: Our AI is trained on thousands of real furniture items, but the generated images are synthetic representations. However, you can browse our catalog to find similar purchasable items from our partners.

items.question: Can I remove existing furniture?
items.answer: Yes! Our Object Removal and 'Redesign' mode allowing you to clear a room or replace existing furniture with a new style instantly.

items.question: Do I need professional photos?
items.answer: No. Our AI enhances your photos automatically. While professional photos yield the best results, even smartphone photos can be transformed into high-quality marketing assets.

items.question: What happens if I don't like the result?
items.answer: We offer free regenerations if the AI produces glitches. You can also use our 'Magic Edit' tool to fix specific areas without restaging the whole room.
